title: Midjourney Acquires Astrology Social App Co-Star with 4.3 Million Monthly Active Users, Team Fully Integrated

content_html:
Bloomberg reported that AI laboratory Midjourney, known for its AI image and video generation tools, has acquired the social astrology app Co-Star. The terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Co-Star has approximately 4.3 million monthly active users and primarily helps users generate and share astrological birth charts. The app combines AI and human-written astrology forecasts, compatibility assessments, and other recommendations based on users' astrological information.

Midjourney is showing a trend of diversified expansion in its product lineup. This company is almost synonymous with text and image generation services on Discord servers—until now, it has not had an independent Midjourney app—but it has previously tried to establish a healthcare division and a spa business. The acquisition of Co-Star further expands its product line.

As part of the acquisition, the entire team of about 24 people from Co-Star has joined Midjourney. Considering the team's experience in developing consumer-level applications, Midjourney may finally be able to launch its own independent app.

content_html_zh:
彭博社报道称，以人工智能图像和视频生成工具而闻名的人工智能实验室 Midjourney 已收购社交占星应用程序 Co-Star。 交易条款并未披露。

Co-Star 每月约有 430 万活跃用户，主要帮助用户生成和分享占星出生图。 该应用程序结合了人工智能和人工编写的占星预测、兼容性评估以及基于用户占星信息的其他建议。

中途的产品阵容呈现多元化扩张的趋势。 这家公司几乎是 Discord 服务器上的文本和图像生成服务的代名词——到目前为止，它还没有独立的 Midjourney 应用程序——但它之前曾尝试建立医疗保健部门和水疗业务。 收购Co-Star进一步扩大了其产品线。

作为收购的一部分，Co-Star 的整个团队（约 24 人）已加入 Midjourney。 考虑到团队在开发消费级应用程序方面的经验，Midjourney 或许最终能够推出自己的独立应用程序。
